world.title: Meet Olivia Shone, the 19-year-old who built a $600,000 investment house after she began saving at 16, while serving in Australia’s military and studying law
world.summary: Nineteen-year-old Olivia Shone has purchased a four-bedroom investment house in Warragul, Victoria, valued at $600,000. She began saving at age 16 while serving in the Australian military and studying law. Shone's childhood was marked by her mother's death when she was 11, leading her to assist her father on their family farm and work at an equestrian facility.

world.title: ‘Iran is DEAD!’ Trump declares Tehran a ‘failed nation’, claims no navy, no air force and 300% inflation as war escalates
world.summary: Trump labeled Iran a "Failed Nation," asserting its military and economy are in decline, citing a lack of navy and air force, along with 300% inflation. His remarks followed missile strikes from Tehran in response to a recent US attack near the Strait of Hormuz. The escalating tensions highlight ongoing conflicts between the two nations.

world.title: Taliban makes $1 trillion lucrative offer to US in exchange for sanctions relief
world.summary: Afghanistan's Taliban government has proposed a $1 trillion deal to the United States, seeking sanctions relief in exchange for access to its extensive mineral resources. The Taliban aims to attract US investment in mining and other sectors while requesting the release of billions of dollars in frozen assets. This initiative marks an effort to improve relations with the US.

business.title: GRT Jewellers to acquire 74% stake of Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri for Rs 1,034 crore
business.summary: GRT Jewellers announced its acquisition of a 74% stake in Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri for up to Rs 1,034 crore. Additionally, GRT will initiate an open offer for an extra 26% stake, in accordance with SEBI regulations. This strategic move aims to strengthen GRT's position in the jewellery market, as confirmed by a joint statement from both companies.

business.title: Milky Mist Q1 results: Net profit jumps over 1,000% to Rs 64.5 crore, revenue rises 45%
business.summary: Milky Mist Dairy Food Ltd reported a standalone net profit of Rs 64.5 crore for Q1, ending June 30, 2026, marking an increase of over 1,000%. Revenue also rose by 45%, driven by strong sales across its entire product portfolio. The results reflect broad-based growth, indicating a successful quarter for the company in the dairy sector.

business.title: Old Monk maker agrees to modify bottle labels after Bombay High Court questions 7-year age claims
business.summary: The Bombay High Court has ordered the Old Monk rum maker to modify its bottle labels after questioning claims of a seven-year aging process. The court criticized the fine print regarding added flavors, stating it misleads consumers. The court denied interim relief against the FSSAI's stop-sale order in Maharashtra, emphasizing the importance of clear labeling for public understanding.

technology.title: Android 17 QPR2 Beta 4 fixes an APK sideloading pain point
technology.summary: Android 17 QPR2 Beta 4 introduces improvements for APK sideloading, enhancing security with one-time permissions and simplified inline prompts. Previously, users faced an all-or-nothing toggle for app installation privileges, which remained active until manually revoked. The update aims to streamline the process, making it easier for users to manage APK installation permissions without navigating through multiple settings.

technology.title: Sony Gets Fans Hopes Up With September 2026 State Of Play
technology.summary: Sony has announced a September PlayStation State of Play Showcase to launch the fall gaming season. The event will feature a detailed look at Final Fantasy VII Revelation. Fans are eager to see updates on Sony's first-party games, including Intergalactic. The back-to-back broadcasts aim to generate excitement among the gaming community as new content is revealed.

technology.title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 Review: Brilliantly Compact, Signifcant Improvements, Familiar Compromises
technology.summary: The Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 offers significant improvements over its predecessors, featuring a refined hinge, less visible crease, and a cover screen capable of running real apps. This model enhances the flip-phone experience while maintaining familiar compromises. Overall, it is considered the most polished version in the Galaxy Z Flip lineup, focusing on refinement rather than major changes.

sports.title: 19 title at CISCE Regional Cricket Tournament
sports.summary: The CISCE Regional Cricket Tournament 2026, held at Adarsh School in Karnal, concluded after two days of matches. The event featured teams from 11 zones, including Haryana, Amritsar, Ludhiana, Gurdaspur, Delhi NCR, Moga, Muktsar, Hoshiarpur, Himachal, Jalandhar, and Chandigarh. Competitions were conducted in the Under-17 and Under-19 Boys categories, showcasing emerging cricket talent across the regions.

sports.title: Duleep Trophy: Tilak Varma, Shreyas Gopal script turnaround
sports.summary: In the Duleep Trophy semifinal, South Zone staged a remarkable comeback against North Zone, led by Tilak Varma and Shreyas Gopal. After East Zone's Vaibhav Sooryavanshi scored 92, East Zone collapsed from 161/0 to 266 all out. South Zone finished the first innings with a lead, recovering from an initial score of 40/2 by stumps.

sports.title: Mohammad Abbas doesn’t mince words, admits Pakistan are playing bad cricket: ‘Everyone is worried’
sports.summary: Pakistan pacer Mohammad Abbas expressed concern over the team's poor performance, acknowledging that consecutive losses are troubling. Following a 194-run defeat to England in the second Test at Lord’s, Abbas highlighted the team's struggles, despite his personal achievement of taking nine wickets. This loss marks Pakistan's second straight defeat in the ongoing Test series against England.

health.title: How blood pressure intervention lowers dementia risk
health.summary: A community-based trial in rural China demonstrated that an intensive blood-pressure lowering intervention significantly reduced dementia incidence compared to usual care. These findings were presented at the ESC Congress 2026, highlighting the potential of managing hypertension to mitigate dementia risk. The study is part of the China Rural Hypertension Control Program, addressing the growing global dementia prevalence.

health.title: Listening to deep sleep brain waves may reduce the progression of Alzheimer’s disease
health.summary: A recent study suggests that listening to deep sleep brain waves may help reduce the progression of Alzheimer’s disease. Historically, scientists have thought little could be done to alter its course. This new finding indicates that enhancing sleep quality could potentially influence the impact of Alzheimer’s, offering a promising avenue for further research and therapeutic strategies in managing the disease.

science.title: SpaceX Falcon 9 stage slammed into Moon, carving 60-foot crater
science.summary: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket stage collided with the Moon on August 5, creating a 60-foot-wide crater near the Einstein crater. The impact, occurring at a speed of 8,694 km/h, involved a piece weighing approximately 3,629 kg. NASA's images show the disturbed surface material resulting from the high-speed collision, highlighting the ongoing effects of space debris.

science.title: SpaceX rocket crashes into Moon and leaves a giant 60-foot crater
science.summary: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket stage crashed into the Moon on August 5, creating a crater approximately 60 feet wide. NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter captured images showing the impact site, which is less than 10 feet deep. The incident highlights the increasing presence of human-made objects on the lunar surface and their potential effects on the Moon's environment.

science.title: Optical control of electrons in a Floquet topological insulator
science.summary: Researchers have achieved optical control of electrons in light-dressed graphene, creating a Floquet topological insulator using circularly polarized femtosecond laser pulses. This method, termed harmonic Floquet spectroscopy, allows dynamic manipulation of electrons, leading to phenomena such as photocurrent circular dichroism and valley-polarized currents. The findings suggest potential advancements in ultrafast control within topological electronics and quantum materials.

entertainment.title: Monday Stories: Toxic Huge Disaster, Irumudi Epic Blockbuster!
entertainment.summary: In this week's Monday Stories, the film "Vishwanath and Sons" is nearing its break-even point, currently grossing 198 Crore after three weekends. Despite this progress, the movie is considered an underperformer and a financial loss in the Tamil film industry. The article discusses the film's performance and its implications for future projects in the region.

entertainment.title: Shalini Pandey reacts to her viral AI-generated obscene video: 'It is deeply disturbing to see, I strongly condemn this kind of abuse'
entertainment.summary: Shalini Pandey has condemned a viral AI-generated video that falsely depicts her in an obscene manner. The actress described the situation as deeply disturbing and categorically dismissed the clip as fake. Pandey emphasized the harmful nature of such abuse and expressed her disapproval of its circulation on social media platforms, highlighting the need for accountability in digital content.

entertainment.title: Sabyasachi just opened a lavish 26,000 square foot store in Delhi: Here's what true luxury actually means to him
entertainment.summary: Sabyasachi has opened a 26,000 square foot store in Delhi, emphasizing that true luxury is not merely transactional. The fashion designer believes in the importance of physical stores, even in a digital age, to enhance the luxury experience. His approach focuses on detail and storytelling, reflecting a commitment to creating a deeper connection with customers.
